name: n8n-hubspot-deal-split-revenue-attribution-calculator
description: n8n revenue engine that calculates weighted credit and commission splits across reps and partner channels when a HubSpot deal reaches Closed-Won, and syncs exact breakdowns to HubSpot, Google Sheets and an analytics database.
author: DH Robin (dhRobin Systems) (https://dhrobinsystems.com)

scripts.lint: node --check calculator.js && node --check scripts/build-workflow.js && node --check test/calculator.test.js && node --check test/workflow.test.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('workflow.json','utf8'))"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build:check && npm test
